distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) treated the earlier Taiwan attribution as doubtful, probably based on Shiraki material. Lin & Beaver (2021) later confirmed occurrence with 47 specimens from Yuchi Township, Nantou. The historical doubt is retained as provenance but is superseded for current occurrence assessment.

host_note: Lin & Beaver (2021) directly bred the Taiwan series from Fraxinus formosana and identified it as a new host species. Beaver & Liu (2010) contributes no host evidence to the doubtful historical record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hylesinus tristis Blandford, 1894.

nomenclature_note: Canonical identity remains Hylesinus tristis Blandford, 1894, VSN_3018. Historical occurrence uncertainty did not represent a taxon-identity change.
